questionText: does eclipse kill a unit that has 4 or less might
question: does the unit die?

premise.notes: Eclipse = [Reaction], 'give a unit -4 Might this turn'. Modeled as modifyMight -4 on a 4-Might unit (the worst case of '4 or less'). The unit has no damage marked, so even at 0 effective Might it should not die by a state-based check (death requires nonzero marked damage >= current Might, rule 143.2.a; 0 Might alone is not lethal, rule 143.2.b).
